title: Content Item Completed
description: Emitted when a student finishes a content item. For modules: scroll-to-end + minimum-time threshold. For quizzes: submission. For labs: success state.

totalActiveMs.description: Cumulative active time on this item across all sessions, in milliseconds

totalSessions.description: Number of distinct sessions in which this item was engaged

score.description: If applicable (quiz/exam/lab), the final score; null otherwise

passed.description: If applicable, did the student pass; null otherwise
